headline: What is Social Proof?
body: Social proof shows potential customers that others have tried and liked your product or service, building trust and confidence.
caption:
Think about how you pick a restaurant: you might choose the one with more people inside, or check out online reviews before you go. For your own online business, this means showing off happy customer testimonials, reviews, or even how many people follow you or have bought your products.
